instrument: single BitMEX XBTUSD inverse perpetual; BTC collateral
objective: differential Sharpe ratio of net BTC equity log growth, including commission, slippage and funding
algorithm: recurrent PPO with a clipped enumerated counterfactual policy gradient and action-value regression; automatically tuned direction entropy

references.horizon and holding priors: derived from the measured 14.8 bp five-minute return standard deviation and the resulting 22 h cost break-even
references.update budget: CleanRL ppo_atari_lstm: 10M steps at 1024 batch, 4 epochs over 4 minibatches = 156,240 actor gradient steps
references.clip, gradient clip, annealing, advantag: Andrychowicz et al., What Matters In On-Policy RL, ICLR 2021 (250,000 agents)
references.burn-in ratio: Kapturowski et al., R2D2, ICLR 2019: 80-step sequences behind a 40-step burn-in
references.network width evidence: Tummon, Raja & Ryan 2020 reached 256 hidden units by Optuna search on a BitMEX crypto task; CleanRL ppo_atari_lstm uses 128 for its recurrent baseline
references.entropy on a discrete action space: CleanRL Atari configurations carry a fixed ent_coef of 0.01; Andrychowicz find regularisation unnecessary only because Gaussian policies in continuous control explore by construction

reward: Moody & Saffell (2001) differential Sharpe ratio on per-step net log BTC equity change; the running mean and second moment are part of the observation, without which the reward depends on unobserved history and the critic cannot fit it
cost_policy: fixed at the realistic 5 bp commission plus 1 bp adverse slippage per leg throughout training; no curriculum; robustness reported by re-scoring at higher slippage
exploration: trainable side-specific continuation bias initialised to 0.995 flat and 0.9965 holding; entropy target applied to P(side | switch) only, uniformly across states and never weighted by P(switch), which would let the agent escape the penalty by never switching
sizing: entry notional is 1x account equity and is not rebalanced; the differential Sharpe reward prices out the leverage-reset flicker on its own, because raising exposure scales return and volatility together while the fees are pure loss
evaluation: sampled actions over several seeds, reported as a distribution; overlapping 90-day blocks stepped 15 days at selection; argmax is never used
initial_training_states: one-third untouched flat histories, otherwise a persistent random-action prefix builds valid flat/long/short histories including costs; evaluation always starts flat
counterfactual: all three first actions on copied ledgers, then sampled current-policy continuation and a value bootstrap; no fake on-policy samples
